data.title: 門市人員_全通路銷售助理(兼職) - Omnichannel Sales Advisor (PT)【新北新店DECATHLON】
data.description: 想要與一群熱愛運動的人一起工作、樂於分享運動的喜悅嗎？歡迎加入我們！ 成為全通路銷售助理(兼職)，將會負責以下其中一項運動，和團隊一起達成業績目標。 - 健身 - 跑步 - 自行車 工作職責： 1. 在全通路銷售產品及推廣永續的價值及服務，以滿足顧客需求 - 於實體或數位通路銷售符合顧客需求之現有產品 - 提供幫助延長產品使用壽命的基本維修服務或個人化服務 2. 佈置全通路陳列滿足顧客體驗，激發顧客探索我們的產品 - 確保實體及數位通路產品庫存充足 - 透過環保設計、二手商品管理、維修服務、展現迪卡儂永續價值 Want to work with a team of sports lovers and inspire others with your passion? Join us and grow together! As an Omnichannel Sales Advisor, you will be responsible for one of the following sports and work with the team to achieve sales targets. We are currently looking for candidates in the following departments: Fitness Running Cycling Responsibilities: 1.Delight my customers in all channels by selling durable products/services solutions suitable to their needs. -Sell physically or digitally our available products that meet our customer's needs. -Offer basic repair services, helping to extend a product's lifespan or personalisation services 2.Delight my customers with customer-friendly, experiential, omnichannel and safe layouts that make them want to discover our sports and solutions. -Guarantee our products' physical and digital availability -Acting through actions that preserve our resources and our societal impact
locations: 新店區, 新北市, 台灣
